name: Inoy Mir 3: LAST
source:
Do you believe in the existence of angels?
What awaits us after death?
The afterlife, or emptiness?
What is the most valuable thing in life to you?
So many questions, and so few answers...
translation:
你相信天使的存在吗？
死后等待着我们的究竟是什么？
是彼岸来生，还是一片虚无？
对你而言，生命中最宝贵的事物又是什么？
如此多的问题，答案却寥寥无几……
